divergences.upstreamResult: Base UI integrates with React synthetic handlers while preserving native input behavior.
divergences.octaneResult: The Octane binding integrates directly with native input events.
divergences.rationale: Octane intentionally uses the browser event model rather than React's synthetic event layer.
divergences.consumerImpact: Handler timing and event object details can differ when consumers inspect React-specific fields.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Use native input semantics and avoid depending on React SyntheticEvent-only fields.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review if Octane adds a React-compatible synthetic event layer.

divergences.upstreamResult: React composes render-element refs and class names through React element cloning semantics.
divergences.octaneResult: Octane reproduces the rendered result through its native ref-as-prop and class composition model.
divergences.rationale: The frameworks expose different internal element and ref composition primitives.
divergences.consumerImpact: React-only element identity or ref implementation details are not portable even when DOM output matches.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Depend on the resulting DOM, composed class names, and public refs rather than React element identity.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review if Octane changes render-element or ref composition semantics.

divergences.upstreamResult: Base UI includes private hover infrastructure used by upstream components.
divergences.octaneResult: The private hover helper is not exposed or independently ported; public supported components use Octane-native behavior.
divergences.rationale: Private upstream internals are not a public compatibility surface.
divergences.consumerImpact: Consumers cannot import undocumented Base UI hover internals from the Octane package.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Use public component APIs or Octane's native hover primitives.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review if a public supported component requires the missing internal helper.

divergences.upstreamResult: Base UI NumberField includes ScrubArea and additional pointer and keyboard interaction behavior.
divergences.octaneResult: The current Octane NumberField supports formatting and step controls but not ScrubArea or the complete interaction matrix.
divergences.rationale: Those interaction surfaces have not yet been ported and must remain explicit gaps.
divergences.consumerImpact: Consumers needing scrub gestures or the full upstream interaction matrix cannot migrate without adaptation.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Use the supported input and stepper surface, or keep Base UI React for ScrubArea-dependent flows.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review when ScrubArea or the remaining NumberField interactions are implemented.
